sources.title: PLACEHOLDER — Reference work on world food forms

description.text: Small portions of dough, either wrapped around a filling or shaped on their own, cooked by boiling, steaming, frying or baking.
Membership turns on each piece being individual and small; large filled pies and loaves belong to the pie and bread families.

images.alt: Steamed momo on a metal plate, pleated at the top.
